label: RPCD-H1-final
scope: AX3000T isolated direct ubus RPCD workload; no HTTP end-to-end or production deployment

method.center: median of three independent per-window statistics
method.range: minimum and maximum of three per-window statistics; not uncertainty interval
method.paired_directions: same block H1 minus baseline; up/down refers to numeric value; higher throughput is better, all other metrics lower is better
method.latency: invoke wall latency; response JSON validation is outside individual latency but inside caller CPU and throughput wall interval
method.quantile: sorted samples[floor((N-1)*q+0.5)]; c4 pools four client samples inside each window only
method.c4_daemon_cpu_denominator: successful plus 80 warmups; one outer interval includes client startup, lookup, warmup and completion
method.c4_caller_cpu_denominator: successful; sum four client measured CPU intervals; no overlapping daemon interval sum
method.c4_throughput: successful divided by outer /proc/uptime elapsed, including startup and warmup; 0.01s export resolution
method.rpcd_children: reaped children cutime+cstime exported at 100Hz; 10ms tick
method.rpcd_tree: own process CPU plus reaped child CPU computed per window before aggregation
method.own_clock: process CPU clock; 1ns advertised resolution is not a claim of 1ns measurement accuracy
method.child_representation_bound: conservative two ticks per window difference; counter-export representation only, not kernel accounting accuracy
method.timeout: invoke limit 5000ms; fail-fast on invoke/validation failure; no independent timeout counter is exported
scope_limits: only three windows per implementation; no statistical significance claim
CPU components have different c4 boundaries and denominators; their naive sum is not exact common-boundary system CPU
R89 versus H1 includes inherited ubus changes; timing alone does not establish scheduler causality
separate current-versus-H1 screens, handler timings and resources are not mixed into this matrix
